page.content:
Youngest daughter who will not flatter Lear and later dies for him.

How Cordelia connects

  • Work: King Lear — Cordelia is the daughter Lear casts out and later mourns.
  • Character: King Lear (character) — Lear's demand for love and Cordelia's 'Nothing' open the tragedy.

What is Cordelia?

Cordelia is the daughter who answers 'Nothing' when Lear demands a speech of love, is cast out, and returns with an army only to die in the play's last movement.

Key threads lead to King Lear and King Lear (character).
